blocks.title: A layers editor in the side panel
blocks.description: Layers, masks, type and real PSD files — the upstream Photocraft editor running inside Astravia, on your own machine, with the file you opened in the workspace.

showcase.user_prompt: In Photocraft, open @assets/cover.png, add a curves layer that pulls the highlights down, and export a 1600 px JPEG beside it.
showcase.assistant_reply: Cover open, curves layer added with the highlight end pulled down. Exported cover-1600.jpg next to the original — say the word if the white point should go lower.

items.title: The real editor, unmodified
items.description: The tab runs the official Photocraft web build byte for byte into the tab's iframe. Upstream's wasm and JavaScript are not patched; only two thin files of ours are added around them.

items.title: Open and save inside your project
items.description: Opening uses the file you selected in the Explorer, and saving writes back through Astravia — so the bytes land in your workspace instead of a downloads folder.

items.title: Speak to it in the conversation
items.description: Open the editor, read the canvas, run a batch of pointer and key steps, then read the canvas again to check — five tools the Agent calls, each one answered by the running page.

items.title: A retouch you can see before it saves
items.description: Layers are selected, adjustments opened, the brush used — and the canvas is captured between steps, so the retouch is judged on the picture rather than on a description of it.

items.title: Install the plugin
items.description: Add it from the marketplace. The editor ships inside the plugin, so there is nothing to fetch.

items.title: Open the Photocraft tab
items.description: Opening the tab shows the editor itself — no preparation screen, no package to fetch.

items.title: Select an image in the Explorer, then open it
items.description: Inside the editor, File → Open takes the file you selected instead of showing a dialog.

items.title: Save back with File → Save
items.description: The working copy is written to the same path. Export… asks where to save instead.

blocks.content: Photocraft has no way to tell the panel whether a document has unsaved edits, so reloading the tab asks nothing. The editor's own title bar is the only unsaved marker.

The agent does not run a script inside the editor: it moves the pointer, presses the tools and types the numbers a hand would, one step at a time. After a retouch it reads the canvas back — its text map and its average colour — before saying the background changed.
